feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 1 May 2026 4:48pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Friday, 01 May 2026 at 4:40pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

High pressure in the mid-Atlantic and an area of low pressure to the west of Ireland. Various frontal zones affect the British Isles.


##Wind##

Mainly south or southwest 3 to 5, but variable 3 or less in the east of the area .


##State of Sea##

Slight.


##Weather##

Outbreaks of rain in the east at first, then showers. Risk of coastal mist or fog patches.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in rain or showers, poor in any mist and very poor in fog patches.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or southwest 3 to 5 but variable 3 or less in the east. Becoming variable (mainly north) 2 to 4 in all waters Saturday evening.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight.


##Weather##

Isolated showers, then outbreaks of rain approaching from the south overnight into Sunday. Areas of mist and isolated fog patches, mainly to start.


##Visibility##

Moderate or good, occasionally poor in mist, showers or rain. Very poor in fog patches.
